manifest.title: 投资吐槽
manifest.description: 抄底、回撤、FOMO 与复盘：投资英语短句

items.text: I bought the dip and the dip kept dipping.
items.hint: 我抄底了，底却还在跌。

items.text: My portfolio is diversified across different shades of red.
items.hint: 我的组合分散在不同深浅的红色里。

items.text: The influencer called it easy money yesterday.
items.hint: 网红昨天还管这叫轻松赚钱。

items.text: I checked prices again and nothing useful changed.
items.hint: 我又看了一眼行情，没什么有用的变化。

items.text: Paper hands is what I call my past self.
items.hint: 纸手，说的就是过去的我。

items.text: The earnings call said strong; the chart said run.
items.hint: 业绩会说强劲，图表说快跑。

items.text: I set a stop-loss and watched it get hunted.
items.hint: 我设了止损，然后看着它被打掉。

items.text: My hot tip cooled down before I could act.
items.hint: 热门内幕还没等我动手就凉了。

items.text: I confused volatility with opportunity again.
items.hint: 我又把波动当成了机会。

items.text: The index is fine; my stock picks are not.
items.hint: 指数没事，我的选股有事。

items.text: I dollar-cost averaged into a lesson.
items.hint: 定投进去的是一堂课。

items.text: My risk tolerance drops after every candle.
items.hint: 每根 K 线后，我的风险承受力都下降。

items.text: I read three theses and followed none of them.
items.hint: 我读了三篇逻辑，一条都没执行。

items.text: The FOMO hit harder than the fee schedule.
items.hint: FOMO 比手续费表还狠。

items.text: I sold for peace of mind and bought regret.
items.hint: 我为安心卖出，买回了后悔。

items.text: My watchlist is longer than my conviction list.
items.hint: 观察名单比信念名单长。

items.text: The macro story changes every news cycle.
items.hint: 宏观故事每个新闻周期都变。

items.text: I hedged late and paid for the privilege.
items.hint: 我对冲晚了，还为晚付了学费。

items.text: Green days feel genius; red days feel educational.
items.hint: 绿的时候像天才，红的时候像上课。

items.text: I checked Twitter before the financials. Mistake.
items.hint: 我先看推特再看财报。失误。

items.text: My rebalance plan waited for a perfect entry forever.
items.hint: 再平衡计划永远在等完美入场点。

items.text: The dividend looked nice until I did the math.
items.hint: 股息看着不错，直到我算了一下。

items.text: I confuse busy trading with actual strategy.
items.hint: 我把忙碌交易当成了真正策略。

items.text: The bull case needs three miracles and good luck.
items.hint: 多头逻辑需要三个奇迹再加运气。

items.text: I muted price alerts and still refreshed the app.
items.hint: 我关了价格提醒，却还是刷新 App。

items.text: My long-term thesis lasted three weekends.
items.hint: 我的长期逻辑活了三个周末。

items.text: I bought quality and forgot about timing.
items.hint: 我买了优质标的，忘了时机。

items.text: The cash position feels smart until the rally starts.
items.hint: 持有现金在上涨开始前都很聪明。

items.text: I journaled the trade after the damage was done.
items.hint: 亏损发生后，我才写交易日志。

items.text: My leverage lesson was expensive and clear.
items.hint: 杠杆这一课又贵又清楚。

items.text: I followed smart money and arrived last.
items.hint: 我跟着聪明钱，结果到得最晚。

items.text: The sector rotation spun me in circles.
items.hint: 板块轮动把我转晕了。

items.text: I wanted alpha and got tracking error.
items.hint: 我想要超额收益，得到了跟踪误差。

items.text: My options expired with optimism intact.
items.hint: 期权到期了，乐观还在。

items.text: I average down until the story changes, then panic.
items.hint: 故事变之前我摊低成本，然后恐慌。

items.text: The conference keynote was bullish; my account was not.
items.hint: 大会演讲很看多，我的账户不。

items.text: I confuse a good company with a good entry.
items.hint: 我把好公司和好买点搞混了。

items.text: My backtest ignored fees, spreads, and emotions.
items.hint: 回测忽略了费用、点差和情绪。

items.text: I waited for confirmation and missed the move.
items.hint: 我等确认信号，错过了行情。

items.text: The inflation trade worked until it did not.
items.hint: 抗通胀交易一直有效，直到失效。

items.text: I treat every bounce like a new bull market.
items.hint: 我把每次反弹都当新牛市。

items.text: My due diligence was a thread and a vibe.
items.hint: 我的尽调是一条帖子和一种感觉。

items.text: I rebalanced by selling winners too early.
items.hint: 我通过过早卖掉赢家来再平衡。

items.text: The overnight gap taught me about sleeping.
items.hint: 隔夜跳空教会我什么叫睡觉。

items.text: I wanted passive income and got active anxiety.
items.hint: 我想要被动收入，得到了主动焦虑。

items.text: My conviction position became a hope position.
items.hint: 信念仓位变成了希望仓位。

items.text: I charted support and watched it become resistance.
items.hint: 我画出支撑，看着它变成阻力。

items.text: The newsletter said unique insight, weekly.
items.hint: 通讯说这是独特见解，每周都说。

items.text: I taxed my gains with bad behavior fees.
items.hint: 我用糟糕行为给收益额外征了税。

items.text: My portfolio review is mostly scrolling and sighing.
items.hint: 组合复盘主要是滑动和叹气。

items.text: I learned compounding works both ways.
items.hint: 我学会了复利是双向的。

items.text: The safe asset was boring until everything else screamed.
items.hint: 安全资产一直很无聊，直到别处都在尖叫。

items.text: I set rules sober and broke them at open.
items.hint: 冷静时定规则，开盘时打破。

items.text: My edge was patience; I spent it on clicks.
items.hint: 我的优势是耐心，却花在了点击上。

items.text: I wanted a ten-bagger and collected ten lessons.
items.hint: 我想要十倍股，收集了十堂课。

items.text: The liquidity vanished when I needed an exit.
items.hint: 我要离场时，流动性消失了。

items.text: I confuse narrative with numbers after two coffees.
items.hint: 两杯咖啡后，我把叙事和数字搞混。

items.text: My long-only strategy became long and wrong.
items.hint: 我的只做多策略变成又长又错。

items.text: I closed the app for peace and opened it for fear.
items.hint: 我为平静关掉 App，又因恐惧打开。

items.text: Markets can stay irrational longer than my patience.
items.hint: 市场保持非理性的时间，比我的耐心更长。
